name: Naphthalene
aliases: Tolboxane, Mothballs, Albocarbon, Camphor tar, naphthalin, Naphthaline, Naphthene, tar camphor
summary: Naphthalene is an organic compound with the chemical formula C10H8.08 ppm. As an aromatic hydrocarbon, naphthalene's structure consists of a fused pair of benzene rings, making it a simple and rather symmetrical polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon (PAH). It is the main ingredient of traditional mothballs.
